principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

title: Clean-then-place sequence with synonym acceptance and sinkbasin verification

- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_010 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Clean-then-place sequence with synonym acceptance and sinkbasin verification
principle: For clean-and-place goals, locate and take the target object (accepting a close synonym such as pan for pot, butterknife for knife, or mug for cup if the literal name is absent), navigate to a sinkbasin, clean the held object, then navigate to the destination receptacle and put the object there. If clean fails, verify you are at the sinkbasin before retrying.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object in/on a target receptacle and the object is not already clean.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_011 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed destination receptacles before placing, but do not retry a no-op open
principle: If the destination receptacle is closed, open it before attempting to put the clean object inside. If 'open' itself returns 'Nothing happens' (already open or non-openable), proceed directly to put rather than retrying open.
when_to_apply: When the target destination is a closed cabinet, drawer, fridge, microwave, or similar container.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_012 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not clean non-cleanable objects such as towels
principle: Some objects, such as towels, cannot be cleaned with a sinkbasin; repeated clean attempts fail and waste steps.
when_to_apply: When the target object is a towel or another object that does not support the clean action.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_013 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not assume coffeemachine accepts placed mugs
principle: A coffeemachine may not be a valid placement receptacle for a clean mug; put attempts can fail even when holding the correct object.
when_to_apply: When the goal destination is a coffeemachine and the put action returns no effect.

Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_010 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Clean-then-place sequence with synonym acceptance and sinkbasin verification
principle: For clean-and-place goals, locate and take the target object (accepting a close synonym such as pan for pot, butterknife for knife, or mug for cup if the literal name is absent), navigate to a sinkbasin, clean the held object, then navigate to the destination receptacle and put the object there. If clean fails, verify you are at the sinkbasin before retrying.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object in/on a target receptacle and the object is not already clean.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_011 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Open closed destination receptacles before placing, but do not retry a no-op open
principle: If the destination receptacle is closed, open it before attempting to put the clean object inside. If 'open' itself returns 'Nothing happens' (already open or non-openable), proceed directly to put rather than retrying open.
when_to_apply: When the target destination is a closed cabinet, drawer, fridge, microwave, or similar container.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_012 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not clean non-cleanable objects such as towels
principle: Some objects, such as towels, cannot be cleaned with a sinkbasin; repeated clean attempts fail and waste steps.
when_to_apply: When the target object is a towel or another object that does not support the clean action.
[Task-specific: 清洗后放置 | skill_013 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not assume coffeemachine accepts placed mugs
principle: A coffeemachine may not be a valid placement receptacle for a clean mug; put attempts can fail even when holding the correct object.
when_to_apply: When the goal destination is a coffeemachine and the put action returns no effect.

Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_016 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Successful heating and placement sequence
principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object while holding it (take it out first if it is inside), then go to the target and put it there. Track the same instance throughout and do not blindly repeat a failing put; re-verify location, container openness, and held-object state.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.

- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_016 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Successful heating and placement sequence
principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object while holding it (take it out first if it is inside), then go to the target and put it there. Track the same instance throughout and do not blindly repeat a failing put; re-verify location, container openness, and held-object state.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.

principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there

when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.

title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.

when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.

when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.

title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.

title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.

title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces

title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there

- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_016 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Successful heating and placement sequence
principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object while holding it (take it out first if it is inside), then go to the target and put it there. Track the same instance throughout and do not blindly repeat a failing put; re-verify location, container openness, and held-object state.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.

当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_016 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Successful heating and placement sequence
principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object while holding it (take it out first if it is inside), then go to the target and put it there. Track the same instance throughout and do not blindly repeat a failing put; re-verify location, container openness, and held-object state.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.

when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.

title: Successful heating and placement sequence

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.

title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]

how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.

- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_016 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Successful heating and placement sequence
principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object while holding it (take it out first if it is inside), then go to the target and put it there. Track the same instance throughout and do not blindly repeat a failing put; re-verify location, container openness, and held-object state.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.

title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there

when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.

title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there

when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_014 | Failure Lesson]
description: Across many failed trajectories, the agent placed the object in the microwave and then attempted to heat it, resulting in 'Nothing happens.' In successful trajectories, the agent took the object from the microwave (or held it) and then issued the heat command, which succeeded.
why_it_happens: The ALFWorld heat action expects the object to be held by the agent, not merely inside the appliance.
how_to_avoid: After opening the microwave, take the object into inventory, then issue 'heat <object> with microwave 1'.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_015 | Failure Lesson]
description: Many failed trajectories show the agent repeatedly trying 'use microwave 1' and 'heat <object> with microwave 1' without changing the object's location, leading to plan failure. Successful trajectories show that taking the object out and then heating it works.
why_it_happens: The environment does not allow heating an object that is inside the microwave; the object must be held.
how_to_avoid: After a failed heating attempt, take the object from the microwave, then issue the heat command while holding it.
[Task-specific: 加热后放置 | skill_016 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Successful heating and placement sequence
principle: To heat an object and place it in a target receptacle: find and take the object, go to the microwave, open it, heat the object while holding it (take it out first if it is inside), then go to the target and put it there. Track the same instance throughout and do not blindly repeat a failing put; re-verify location, container openness, and held-object state.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to heat an object and put it in a specified location.

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers

principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_017 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and then retrieving it
principle: For cooling tasks, first place the target object into the fridge, then take it out before moving it to the final destination. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory before re-taking.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and then place it in a cabinet, countertop, microwave, garbagecan, diningtable, sidetable, or coffeemachine.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_018 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.
why_it_happens: The agent may assume that any object taken from the fridge is already cool, but the task requires the agent to perform the cooling action.
how_to_avoid: Always put the target object into the fridge before taking it out, even if the object was originally found elsewhere.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_019 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer or wander through unrelated cabinets; episodes burned the full step budget opening empty cabinets without finding the object.
why_it_happens: The agent may continue exhaustive searching or substitute unrelated cabinet visits, wasting steps and failing to complete the task.
how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, if the object is still missing, re-examine the goal or consider that the object may not be present; when navigation to a key receptacle fails, re-evaluate position with 'look' rather than visiting unrelated cabinets.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_017 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and then retrieving it
principle: For cooling tasks, first place the target object into the fridge, then take it out before moving it to the final destination. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory before re-taking.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and then place it in a cabinet, countertop, microwave, garbagecan, diningtable, sidetable, or coffeemachine.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_018 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.
why_it_happens: The agent may assume that any object taken from the fridge is already cool, but the task requires the agent to perform the cooling action.
how_to_avoid: Always put the target object into the fridge before taking it out, even if the object was originally found elsewhere.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_019 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer or wander through unrelated cabinets; episodes burned the full step budget opening empty cabinets without finding the object.
why_it_happens: The agent may continue exhaustive searching or substitute unrelated cabinet visits, wasting steps and failing to complete the task.
how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, if the object is still missing, re-examine the goal or consider that the object may not be present; when navigation to a key receptacle fails, re-evaluate position with 'look' rather than visiting unrelated cabinets.

title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces

when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_017 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and then retrieving it
principle: For cooling tasks, first place the target object into the fridge, then take it out before moving it to the final destination. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory before re-taking.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and then place it in a cabinet, countertop, microwave, garbagecan, diningtable, sidetable, or coffeemachine.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_018 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.
why_it_happens: The agent may assume that any object taken from the fridge is already cool, but the task requires the agent to perform the cooling action.
how_to_avoid: Always put the target object into the fridge before taking it out, even if the object was originally found elsewhere.

description: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer or wander through unrelated cabinets; episodes burned the full step budget opening empty cabinets without finding the object.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_017 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and then retrieving it
principle: For cooling tasks, first place the target object into the fridge, then take it out before moving it to the final destination. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory before re-taking.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and then place it in a cabinet, countertop, microwave, garbagecan, diningtable, sidetable, or coffeemachine.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_018 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the object is not already in the fridge, placing it in the fridge and then taking it out is required; directly taking an object from the fridge without first putting it there does not satisfy the cooling subtask.
why_it_happens: The agent may assume that any object taken from the fridge is already cool, but the task requires the agent to perform the cooling action.
how_to_avoid: Always put the target object into the fridge before taking it out, even if the object was originally found elsewhere.
[Task-specific: 冷却后放置 | skill_019 | Failure Lesson]
description: If the target object is not found in the fridge, countertops, or dining table, do not search every cabinet and drawer or wander through unrelated cabinets; episodes burned the full step budget opening empty cabinets without finding the object.
why_it_happens: The agent may continue exhaustive searching or substitute unrelated cabinet visits, wasting steps and failing to complete the task.
how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, if the object is still missing, re-examine the goal or consider that the object may not be present; when navigation to a key receptacle fails, re-evaluate position with 'look' rather than visiting unrelated cabinets.
