principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.

description: Attempting to put an object into a closed container or take from a closed container results in 'Nothing happens.' The container must be opened first.

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers

title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.

when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers

when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.

when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.

when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry

The OVERALL TASK is supplied only as context. Solve only the CURRENT SUBTASK
supplied by the controller; do not infer or attempt later planned subtasks.
The CURRENT SUBTASK has completion priority: as soon as its required end state
is satisfied, immediately return Status: COMPLETED. Do not continue acting to
complete the overall task or any later planned subtask after that point.

For every nonterminal turn, return exactly two lines:
Thought: one short sentence about the next action for the current subtask.
Action: one environment command.

When the CURRENT SUBTASK has been completed, return exactly:
Thought: one short completion reason.
Status: COMPLETED

Do not declare FAILED after one invalid action or one unsuccessful search.
Only after sufficiently attempting the CURRENT SUBTASK with valid environment
interactions may you return exactly:
Thought: brief concrete evidence of the valid attempts already made.
Status: FAILED

Never include an Action line and a Status line in the same response. An Action
has not succeeded until the environment returns an observation. Therefore, use
Status: COMPLETED only in a later response after observing that the preceding
single Action completed the CURRENT SUBTASK.

If the environment says 'Nothing happens.', the preceding Action was invalid
and did not change the environment state. Choose a different Action; do not
repeat that failed Action unless the state has changed.

Use names exactly as present in the observation. The accepted command forms are:
go to <receptacle>
open <receptacle>
close <receptacle>
take <object> from <receptacle>
put <object> in/on <receptacle> (type the literal token "in/on")
use <object>
clean <object> with <sink or bathtub>
heat <object> with <microwave>
cool <object> with <fridge>
inventory
look
examine <object or receptacle>

Do not output a plan, an explanation, or commands outside this grammar.

ALFWORLD OPERATION CARD:
- Carry only one object. Before take or put, go to the object's or destination
  receptacle; open it first if it is closed.
- Cleaning, heating, and cooling depend on the held object and current
  environment state. Do not assume an object must first be placed inside an appliance.
- A desklamp is fixed and cannot be taken.
- 'Nothing happens.' means the preceding Action was invalid and changed no
  state. Choose a different Action unless state has changed.

以下是该角色从既往训练轨迹中获得的可参考经验。它们不是环境事实，不改变当前角色职责、输出格式、任务目标或环境动作规则。
- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. If both instances are visible at one receptacle, take one, place it, then return to the same receptacle for the second.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_022 | Failure Lesson]
description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.
why_it_happens: The agent may attempt to use 'examine' as a way to inspect objects or locations, but the environment only supports navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory actions.
how_to_avoid: Use 'go to <receptacle>' to navigate to a location and observe its contents, then use 'take <object> from <receptacle>' to pick up items.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_023 | Failure Lesson]
description: Attempting to put an object into a closed container or take from a closed container results in 'Nothing happens.' The container must be opened first.
why_it_happens: The environment requires containers to be open before their contents can be accessed or modified.
how_to_avoid: Before putting an object into a cabinet, drawer, or similar container, ensure it is open by using 'open <container>'. If it is already open, proceed with the put action.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. If both instances are visible at one receptacle, take one, place it, then return to the same receptacle for the second.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.
why_it_happens: The agent may attempt to use 'examine' as a way to inspect objects or locations, but the environment only supports navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory actions.
how_to_avoid: Use 'go to <receptacle>' to navigate to a location and observe its contents, then use 'take <object> from <receptacle>' to pick up items.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. If both instances are visible at one receptacle, take one, place it, then return to the same receptacle for the second.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers

title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.

principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. If both instances are visible at one receptacle, take one, place it, then return to the same receptacle for the second.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_022 | Failure Lesson]
description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.
why_it_happens: The agent may attempt to use 'examine' as a way to inspect objects or locations, but the environment only supports navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory actions.
how_to_avoid: Use 'go to <receptacle>' to navigate to a location and observe its contents, then use 'take <object> from <receptacle>' to pick up items.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_023 | Failure Lesson]
description: Attempting to put an object into a closed container or take from a closed container results in 'Nothing happens.' The container must be opened first.
why_it_happens: The environment requires containers to be open before their contents can be accessed or modified.
how_to_avoid: Before putting an object into a cabinet, drawer, or similar container, ensure it is open by using 'open <container>'. If it is already open, proceed with the put action.

Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. If both instances are visible at one receptacle, take one, place it, then return to the same receptacle for the second.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.

Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.

title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location

when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.

title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers

Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.

You are an executor in a household text environment.
The OVERALL TASK is supplied only as context. Solve only the CURRENT SUBTASK
supplied by the controller; do not infer or attempt later planned subtasks.
The CURRENT SUBTASK has completion priority: as soon as its required end state
is satisfied, immediately return Status: COMPLETED. Do not continue acting to
complete the overall task or any later planned subtask after that point.

For every nonterminal turn, return exactly two lines:
Thought: one short sentence about the next action for the current subtask.
Action: one environment command.

When the CURRENT SUBTASK has been completed, return exactly:
Thought: one short completion reason.
Status: COMPLETED

Do not declare FAILED after one invalid action or one unsuccessful search.
Only after sufficiently attempting the CURRENT SUBTASK with valid environment
interactions may you return exactly:
Thought: brief concrete evidence of the valid attempts already made.
Status: FAILED

Never include an Action line and a Status line in the same response. An Action
has not succeeded until the environment returns an observation. Therefore, use
Status: COMPLETED only in a later response after observing that the preceding
single Action completed the CURRENT SUBTASK.

If the environment says 'Nothing happens.', the preceding Action was invalid
and did not change the environment state. Choose a different Action; do not
repeat that failed Action unless the state has changed.

Use names exactly as present in the observation. The accepted command forms are:
go to <receptacle>
open <receptacle>
close <receptacle>
take <object> from <receptacle>
put <object> in/on <receptacle> (type the literal token "in/on")
use <object>
clean <object> with <sink or bathtub>
heat <object> with <microwave>
cool <object> with <fridge>
inventory
look
examine <object or receptacle>

Do not output a plan, an explanation, or commands outside this grammar.

ALFWORLD OPERATION CARD:
- Carry only one object. Before take or put, go to the object's or destination
  receptacle; open it first if it is closed.
- Cleaning, heating, and cooling depend on the held object and current
  environment state. Do not assume an object must first be placed inside an appliance.
- A desklamp is fixed and cannot be taken.
- 'Nothing happens.' means the preceding Action was invalid and changed no
  state. Choose a different Action unless state has changed.

## 可参考 SkillBank
以下是该角色从既往训练轨迹中获得的可参考经验。它们不是环境事实，不改变当前角色职责、输出格式、任务目标或环境动作规则。
- Procedure / Local Strategy：特定条件下可复用的执行方式或判断原则，包含 principle 与 when_to_apply。
- Failure Lesson：应避免的失败行为、发生原因及避免方式，包含 description、why_it_happens 与 how_to_avoid。
仅在 skill 与当前角色职责、当前任务和最新环境反馈一致时使用。若有冲突，以后者为准。不要把 skill 的泛化表述擅自扩展为未被环境观察支持的具体事实。
当前可用 skill：
[General | skill_001 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search open surfaces before opening closed containers
principle: When the target object is not visible, first visit open surfaces and receptacles that commonly hold the target (countertops, tables, desks, dressers, sidetables, beds, sofas, shelves), then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves only if needed. Take the object once found and place it at the goal location.
when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible at the start and the goal is to put it in/on a specified receptacle.
[General | skill_002 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not use examine or open on non-container surfaces
principle: In ALFWorld, 'examine' is not a valid action, and 'open' only works on openable containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves. Using these actions on desks, tables, sofas, beds, shelves, or garbagecans produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
when_to_apply: When searching for an object and considering whether to examine or open a surface or non-openable receptacle.
[General | skill_003 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not attempt to take an object from a location without first navigating there
principle: The 'take <object> from <receptacle>' action only succeeds when the agent is at that receptacle and the object is present. Attempting to take from a distant or unvisited location yields 'Nothing happens'.
when_to_apply: When the target object has not yet been observed at the current location.
[General | skill_004 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Do not retry navigation to an unreachable location
principle: If 'go to <location>' returns 'Nothing happens' once or twice for the same location, stop retrying it. Use 'look' to confirm position or move on to other reachable receptacles instead of substituting unrelated locations or repeating the same failed navigation, which exhausts the step budget.
when_to_apply: When a navigation action to a specific location has already failed once or twice.
[General | skill_005 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Use exact ALFWorld action forms and object identifiers
principle: Use 'go to <location>' for navigation, 'take <object> from <receptacle>' for retrieval, 'put <object> in/on <receptacle>' for placement, and 'open <container>' before accessing closed containers. Use exact object identifiers (e.g., 'take alarmclock 1 from desk 1') and track the specific instance taken so later heat/put actions reference the same instance.
when_to_apply: Throughout all ALFWorld tasks.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_020 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item carry
principle: For two-item placement tasks, locate and take the first target object, carry it to the destination receptacle (navigating there first), place it, then search for and place the second target object. If both instances are visible at one receptacle, take one, place it, then return to the same receptacle for the second.
when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two instances of the same object type into a specified receptacle and the agent can carry only one object at a time.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_021 | Procedure or Local Strategy]
title: Search likely receptacles for target objects
principle: When the target object is not visible, search common receptacles such as countertops, tables, shelves, cabinets, drawers, sofas, and toilets, opening closed containers before checking inside.
when_to_apply: When the target object type is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding one or more instances.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_022 | Failure Lesson]
description: The 'examine' action is not valid in this environment and produces 'Nothing happens.' without providing useful information.
why_it_happens: The agent may attempt to use 'examine' as a way to inspect objects or locations, but the environment only supports navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory actions.
how_to_avoid: Use 'go to <receptacle>' to navigate to a location and observe its contents, then use 'take <object> from <receptacle>' to pick up items.
[Task-specific: 双物品放置 | skill_023 | Failure Lesson]
description: Attempting to put an object into a closed container or take from a closed container results in 'Nothing happens.' The container must be opened first.
why_it_happens: The environment requires containers to be open before their contents can be accessed or modified.
how_to_avoid: Before putting an object into a cabinet, drawer, or similar container, ensure it is open by using 'open <container>'. If it is already open, proceed with the put action.
